text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has finally arrived.
With the decisive battle at the Kikuka Sho ahead, we need to make the absolute most of this opportunity...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"—Aah, now that we're at the training camp,
it really feels like 'We're finally here!'
and I'm getting all fired up~!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's make this the best summer ever, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go drop off my stuff!
See ya at training!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's see, my room assignment is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fréjus!
You're already in your track jacket?
Talk about fired up~!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...We don't have much time until the 'Kikuka Sho',
so I thought I'd get a head start on training."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Let's both have a great training camp. If you'll excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh.
I can't let myself lose either...!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
“...I need to change soon.
I have to become stronger...!!”

Under the summer sky, with everyone harboring their own feelings,
the scorching training camp begins—
